_comment: Which of mxm-bucket-delay's parameters fill the collection's control roles.
Roles come from docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md, which is normative; parameters are named by
their permanent string id, never by display name.
`fx.delay` already existed and this plugin's Mix is the same quantity - how much delay is
in the mix - so it fills the role rather than minting one. That is mxm-folded-spring's
precedent, and it is what makes the arithmetic below work.
The other seven are new, and they are a NEW PAGE rather than additions to the Effects page,
which mxm-folded-spring's tank filled to its last slot. Seven roles, eight slots, and the
eighth is left free deliberately: an empty slot is inert, and a page with room in it is worth
more than a slot spent to fill it.
Thirteen parameters are deliberately unmapped: the six tap faders, Return, Filter, Routing,
Reverse, Sync, Change and Rate sync. They are the shape you set and store in a preset, not the controls you
reach for while it plays - and that split is what makes one page enough.
Division was a twelfth until 2026-09-06, when Time took over selecting the subdivision and
the parameter went away. fx.delay_time therefore drives the sync division too, which is what
a single Time role should always have meant.
